summary: Scottish soldier of fortune Gregor MacGregor fought in the Spanish American wars of independence, then in the 1820s sold British investors and settlers land in Poyais, a fictional Central American nation, where most of the colonists died.

evidence.note: birth in Stirlingshire on Christmas Eve 1786
arrives in Caracas in spring 1812 and joins Miranda's republican army
trapped in the Spanish siege of Cartagena, organizes the retreat
seizes Amelia Island off Florida and sets up a pirate-licensing government
obtains a Mosquito Coast land grant and invents the country of Poyais
long segment on London speculation and Latin American government bonds
newspaper ads, ballads and a fake guidebook used to sell Poyais
guidebook depicts natives as eager to serve British settlers
settlers land on an undeveloped Mosquito Coast shore; most die of disease
exposed in France, later flees to Caracas and dies there in 1845

notes: main_span ends at the French arrest; the transcript does not date it, 1826 from general knowledge. Jamaica and France get short segments and are left out of setting. Settler deaths include a suicide and dying children, each mentioned briefly, so no content warning added; reviewer may want child-death or suicide-self-harm.
